scheme_name: Nirmaan Kamgar Mrtyu Va Divyangta Sahayta Yojana
description:
Nirmaan Kamgar Mrtyu Va Divyangta Sahayta Yojana is a welfare scheme initiated by the Government of Maharashtra. 

The scheme was launched on 1st April 2018. 

It aims to provide financial assistance to the families of construction workers who have died or become disabled due to accidents while on the job. 

The primary objective of this scheme is to ensure that the families of deceased or disabled construction workers receive adequate financial support. 

This support is crucial as construction workers often work in hazardous conditions. 

The scheme also aims to promote the welfare of construction workers and their dependents. 

The financial assistance provided under this scheme is specifically targeted at mitigating the economic hardships faced by the families of deceased or disabled workers. 

The scheme provides a one-time financial assistance of INR 6,00,000. 

This amount is given to the family of the deceased worker. 

In the case of a worker who becomes disabled due to an accident, the scheme provides assistance of INR 3,00,000. 

This financial support is intended to help cover medical expenses and provide for the family’s livelihood. 

To be eligible for this scheme, the applicant must be a registered construction worker. 

The worker must have been employed in the construction sector at the time of the accident. 

The applicant must also be a resident of Maharashtra. 

There are no specific age limits set for eligibility under this scheme. 

However, the applicant must provide proof of the worker's registration with the Maharashtra Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. 

The application process for the Nirmaan Kamgar Mrtyu Va Divyangta Sahayta Yojana is straightforward. 

Interested applicants must obtain the application form from the local office of the Maharashtra Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. 

The application form can also be downloaded from the official website of the board. 

Applicants must fill out the form with accurate details. 

The following documents are required to complete the application: 

1. Proof of identity of the deceased or disabled worker. 
2. Proof of registration with the Maharashtra Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. 
3. Death certificate in case of death. 
4. Medical certificate in case of disability. 
5. Bank account details of the applicant. 

Once the application form is completed and the necessary documents are gathered, applicants must submit them to the local office of the Maharashtra Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. 

The application will be reviewed by the concerned authorities. 

The processing time for the application is generally around 30 days. 

If approved, the financial assistance will be disbursed directly to the bank account of the applicant. 

The scheme is implemented by the Maharashtra Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. 

This board operates under the Department of Labour of the Government of Maharashtra. 

For any inquiries or assistance, applicants can contact the Maharashtra Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board at their official helpline number. 

The helpline number is available on the board's official website. 

The scheme is part of a broader initiative to improve the welfare of construction workers in Maharashtra. 

The construction sector employs millions of workers in the state. 

Many of these workers face significant risks due to the nature of their work. 

The Nirmaan Kamgar Mrtyu Va Divyangta Sahayta Yojana addresses these risks by providing financial security to workers and their families. 

Since its launch, the scheme has benefited numerous families across Maharashtra. 

The government has reported that thousands of applications have been processed successfully. 

The scheme has been instrumental in providing timely assistance to families in distress. 

It has also raised awareness about the importance of safety measures in the construction industry. 

The financial assistance provided under this scheme is a critical lifeline for many families. 

It helps them cope with the loss of income due to the death or disability of the primary breadwinner. 

In addition to financial assistance, the scheme also emphasizes the need for safety training and awareness programs for construction workers. 

These programs aim to reduce the number of accidents in the construction sector. 

The government is committed to improving the working conditions of construction workers. 

This commitment is reflected in the various welfare schemes and initiatives launched over the years. 

The Nirmaan Kamgar Mrtyu Va Divyangta Sahayta Yojana is a significant step in this direction. 

It not only provides financial support but also promotes the overall welfare of construction workers. 

The scheme is a testament to the government's dedication to protecting the rights and welfare of vulnerable workers. 

By ensuring that families receive the necessary support, the scheme helps to foster a sense of security among construction workers. 

This, in turn, can lead to improved productivity and morale within the workforce. 

The Maharashtra government continues to monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of this scheme. 

Feedback from beneficiaries is taken into account to make necessary improvements. 

The government aims to make the application process as smooth as possible. 

Efforts are being made to streamline the documentation requirements. 

This is to ensure that deserving families do not face unnecessary hurdles in accessing the benefits. 

Overall, the Nirmaan Kamgar Mrtyu Va Divyangta Sahayta Yojana plays a crucial role in supporting the families of construction workers in Maharashtra. 

It provides them with the financial assistance needed to navigate difficult times. 

The scheme is an essential part of the state's broader strategy to enhance the welfare of its workforce. 

Through this initiative, the government demonstrates its commitment to social justice and worker welfare. 

The scheme stands as a model for similar initiatives across other states in India. 

It highlights the importance of targeted support for vulnerable populations in the workforce. 

The Nirmaan Kamgar Mrtyu Va Divyangta Sahayta Yojana is a vital resource for construction workers and their families. 

It ensures that they are not left to fend for themselves in times of crisis. 

The financial assistance provided under this scheme can make a significant difference in the lives of beneficiaries. 

It helps them rebuild their lives and regain stability after a tragic event. 

The scheme reflects the government's recognition of the challenges faced by construction workers. 

It is a proactive approach to ensuring their welfare and security. 

In conclusion, the Nirmaan Kamgar Mrtyu Va Divyangta Sahayta Yojana is a comprehensive welfare initiative. 

It addresses the immediate needs of families affected by the death or disability of construction workers. 

The scheme is a crucial part of Maharashtra's commitment to worker welfare and safety. 

It serves as a beacon of hope for many families in the construction sector.
